source_provenance: existing vendored source; exact upstream commit unverified

obligations.order_payload: Every accepted output equals the oldest outstanding accepted input payload.
obligations.no_unsolicited_output: Every accepted output corresponds to an outstanding accepted input since reset.
obligations.stall_stability: Output valid and payload persist while valid and not ready, except reset cancellation.
obligations.drain_no_loss: After input stops and ready remains asserted, all outstanding accepted inputs drain within the finite experiment bound.
obligations.reset_cancellation: Reset cancels every pending transaction; no pre-reset item may reappear after reset.

handshake: accept iff valid && ready at pre-NBA rising edge
reset: synchronous active high; pending requests and queue contents cancelled
latency: buffered FIFO; variable latency under backpressure; no fixed next-cycle response obligation
capacity: RAM depth rounds up to a power of two; pipeline adds storage; do not assume DEPTH is total capacity
dedup_rule: one gap per mutation and violated obligation; depth/pipeline/seed/waveform are replications, not discoveries
historical_fifo_presented: unknown; these mutants are not a witness for the original presented defect
